metadata.description: Experiments with gen-AI: Claude skills and plugins.

plugins.name: viky-gen-ai-factory
plugins.description: A growing collection of Claude skills: multi-domain Indian law research (constitutional, criminal, family, consumer, cyber/IT, corporate, tax/GST, labour, RTI - sections, case judgments, official sources, Tamil Nadu grievance and legal-aid channels, with a live-research protocol), and Tamil language help (careful writing, translation, proofreading, spelling/grammar checklists, and legal Tamil documents).
